name: Shinsatsu Choukyou Mesu Danshi 〜 Kyousei Kaizou o Isha san Reipu 〜
original_name: 診察調教雌男子〜強制改造・お医者さんレィプ〜
source:
Mitsuya Yamada, a boy with a cold, came in for a checkup.
Under the guise of treatment, I did some naughty things to him...
